description: The Meteosat Visible and InfraRed Imager (MVIRI) on Meteosat-7: water-vapour (6.3 um) and thermal infrared (11.5 um) detectors, nominal and backup (WV1, WV2, IR1, IR2).
notes: Meteosat Visible and InfraRed Imager (MVIRI) on Meteosat-7: water-vapour (WV1, WV2) and thermal infrared (IR1, IR2) detector SRFs from Paul van Delst's SRF archive (ftp://ftp.ssec.wisc.edu/paulv/SRF_Data/netCDF/mviriNOM_m07.srf.nc and mviriBKUP_m07.srf.nc, the 'NOMINAL' and 'BACKUP' spectral configurations; the file comment names the detectors, e.g. 'NOMINAL spectral configuration IR-1 and WV-2'). Visible detectors VIS1-VIS4 and the averaged visible responses of the nominal and backup configurations (VIS_nominal_avg, VIS_backup_avg; EUMETSAT's 'Av. Response') are from EUMETSAT's tables 'Meteosat Normalised Spectral Responses Met-7' (MFG calibration page; PDF fetched from an Internet Archive snapshot of the owner URL, now HTTP 404), 0.30-1.05 um, values unchanged. SVO's single 'VIS' curve (Loew & Govaerts 2010) is not reproduced. IR/WV: wavenumber grid rebuilt from begin/end frequency and point count (checked against summation_srf), converted to Angstrom, sorted; negative samples set to 0; scaled to peak 1. DetectorType=energy is assumed: the owner gives a normalised (relative) spectral response without stating photon or energy weighting; meteorological imager SRFs are applied as weights on spectral radiance (energy convention). SVO's archived records for these instruments carry DetectorType 0 (energy). Source: EUMETSAT MVIRI characterisation via the CIMSS/SSEC SRF archive (P. van Delst; data from HMW).
